data.narrative:
Wraithwatch is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, supplemented by two public market references (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and additional private frontier-defense firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods anchor the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a standard 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the $8M raised as a proxy baseline, yielding $20M. Peer-median analysis across the five comparables—ranging from NODA AI at $125M (Series A) through UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed) to Stark Defence at $4.0B (Series A)—produces a median valuation of $1.0B. These methodologies reflect the wide dispersion typical of early-stage defense-tech valuations, where stage and funding strategy create material variance across cohorts.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $17M (floor, per stage-progression) to $1.1B (ceiling, peer-adjusted upside), with a median of $510M. This wide range reflects acute sensitivity to peer selection within the defense sector, where comparable companies span $125M to $4.0B. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to the peer set, customer acquisition pathway within government and institutional channels, and whether Wraithwatch's product positioning aligns more closely with early-stage ($125M–$1.0B) or growth-stage ($1.0B+) peer precedents.
